root_text:
🚨 Health Alert: HMPV in India 🚨

Cases of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) reported in Gujarat & Bengaluru.
⚠️ Affects infants, elderly & immunocompromised.
🦠 Symptoms: Fever, cough, nasal congestion, breathing issues.
#HMPvirus
